items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: when I had Wardess Gray in 1951, with the sextette.

ctx.x: Well, I felt that, certainly they had something new, different, fresh, young. And something I liked -- and I did want to have them with the band, and as a matter of fact, I had Miles Davis in the band in '46.
Yeah. A little bit later -- maybe in one of these pickup bands that you would put together for a few dates, rather than keep them indefinitely, you also had Wardell Gray.
Oh, yes, well, when I had Wardess Gray in 1951, with the sextette.
